name: Reclaim
description: You touch the ground and nature begins to slowly reclaim an area within a short (10 unit) radius. Non-magical structures, walls, and metallic objects in the area slowly deteriorate and are destroyed over the next minute. Equipped items are not affected.
charge: Constructs within the area must make a resilience check against your spell check or take 20 true damage. Inactive constructs are destroyed by this spell.
